description: This file contains utility functions, test data generation, and list configuration for Keystone.js testing, including functions for creating filters, seed data, and list definitions with various access controls.

methods.name: makeName
methods.description: Generates a string name based on an object of boolean flags, with special handling for 'unique'.

methods.name: countUniqueItems
methods.description: Counts the number of unique items based on their 'id' property.

methods.name: expectEqualItem
methods.description: Asserts that two items are equal based on list fields and optional keys.

methods.name: expectEqualItems
methods.description: Asserts that two arrays of items are equal, with optional sorting and key filtering.

methods.name: makeWhereUniqueFilter
methods.description: Creates a filter object for unique fields based on seeded data.

methods.name: makeWhereFilter
methods.description: Creates a filter object for fields, supporting array of seed data.

methods.name: makeWhereAndFilter
methods.description: Creates an AND filter object for fields, supporting array of seed data.

methods.name: makeFieldEntry
methods.description: Creates a field configuration object with access controls and properties.

methods.name: allowFilter
methods.description: Returns a filter object that allows all IDs.

methods.name: denyFilter
methods.description: Returns a filter object that denies all IDs.

methods.name: makeList
methods.description: Generator function that yields list configurations with various access controls and filters.

methods.name: randomCount
methods.description: Returns a fixed number (6) for random item count.

methods.name: randomString
methods.description: Generates a random string using UUID.

methods.name: seed
methods.description: Creates a single seed item in the database for a list.

methods.name: seedMany
methods.description: Creates multiple seed items in the database for a list.

methods.name: makeItem
methods.description: Creates an item object with fields set to random strings based on operation type.

methods.name: lists
methods.description: Array of list configurations with various access and filter settings.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Exports the Keystone list configuration based on generated lists.
